from brackets import balanced

cases = [
    ('()', True),
    ('([)]', False),
    ('"("', True),
    ('"abc', False),
    ('{"["}', True),
    ('[{()}]', True),
    ('[', False),
    (')', False),
    ('', True),
    ('"a\\"("', True),
    ('"a\\"("b', False),
    ('(")")', True),
    ('{[(', False),
    ('"unterminated (', False),
    ('"esc\\', False),
]

for s, expected in cases:
    got = balanced(s)
    assert got == expected, (s, got, expected)
print('ok')
